upper_rope_offsets_status: Transverse interpretation of raster gantry drawing, not identified by the planar MCT
passage_panelization: 33 alternating truss panels over 49.65 m; module-specific bay labels remain a declared idealization
coincident_floor_members: Ordinary HW gate beam replaces a coincident standalone floor crossbeam; original homogenized permanent mass is retained
deformation_frames: Finite-rotation, ungrounded rigid spreader at each original MCT deformation-frame station; all sixteen rope ports and four down-pull force ports remain separate. Local built-up plate flexibility is not resolved, so this is an explicit stiff-frame approximation, not a detailed frame-shell model.
source_scope: Original design-institute MCT and original engineering review/drawings; no previous calculated spectrum or matrices used
ordinary_floor_elevation_interpretation: MD1-01/03 place tubes above phi50 carrying ropes. Offsets use rope radius plus tube half-depth and explicitly neglect intervening mesh, weld and plate thickness. Large tube 5772 mm excludes closure plates; the depicted overall length is 5780 mm.
large_floor_rope_clamps: MD1-02 note 4 and MD1-01 A-A: sixteen U-bolt connection plates alternate on the two longitudinal sides. Use x offsets +0.075/-0.075 m in rope order, with each point on its actual source polyline. The first side is an explicit orientation convention.
large_floor_clamp_dimension_uncertainty: MD1-01 A-A depicts a 50 mm plate projection, giving a nominal 75 mm center offset from the 100 mm tube; MD1-02 material table instead lists a 45 mm plate dimension. The 75 mm offset is a declared interpretation pending resolution of this original drawing discrepancy.
small_floor_rope_contact: MD1-03 depicts a 50 mm wide tube above the carrying rope, with no U-bolt, bonding, friction or preload specification. Its current single-point attachment is retained here; finite bearing contact remains unresolved.
railing_mass_distribution: MD1-01/02 depict handrail posts on large beams; MD1-03 small beams have no posts. The unchanged railing line mass is assigned by original-source arc-length tributaries only to large, HW and source-frame stations. Frame rail attachment remains part of the stated source-frame idealization.
floor_rope_station_grid: Every floor rope on both decks uses the union of original source stations and all inserted attachment x coordinates; observation mapping reads only existing cable nodes.
passage_mass_distribution: Symmetric over both actual upper chords; no artificial mass eccentricity.
native_solver: Official CCX 2.23 with a documented joint-coordinate preprocessing correction; native element, material and eigensolver formulas unchanged.
auxiliary_witness_elimination: Exactly eliminated massless, unloaded orientation witness points referenced only by their own rigid-body MPCs. All physical members, attachment offsets, masses, supports, reference translation and rotation coordinates, and external compatibility equations are retained. Empty rigid-body cards are omitted; real HW connection patches remain.
